info.title: ZIP Code Distance API - Straight-Line Distance Between ZIP & Postal Codes Worldwide
info.description: Calculate straight-line distances from a base point to up to 100 comparison postal codes in one request. The base point can be specified by a postal code or by exact latitude/longitude coordinates, but a `country` code is required either way. Supports six distance units: kilometers, miles, yards, meters, feet, and inches. Comparison codes with no match are silently omitted from the results array rather than returned as per-item errors — the array can be shorter than the requested compare list.

post.description: Calculates the distance from a base ZIP/postal code or coordinate pair to up to 100 comparison postal codes.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

requestBody.description: Base point (code or coordinates), country, and the list of postal codes to compare against it.

200.description: Successful response with distances. Comparison codes with no match are omitted from results rather than represented as error entries.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing/invalid body, country, or unit, or over the 100-code limit

value.message: Request body is missing required fields or is not in the expected format. Please refer to the API documentation.

MissingCountry.summary: country is required even when the base point is given as coordinates

value.message: Provide a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

BadCountry.summary: country is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.

InvalidUnit.summary: unit is not one of the supported symbols

value.message: The provided unit symbol is invalid. Please refer to the documentation for supported units.
A maximum of 100 postal/zip codes can be processed per request.

404.description: Not Found — None of the compare codes matched anything

value.message: None of the provided postal/zip codes were found in our database.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

ZipcodeDistanceResponse.description: Distance calculation results for each comparison code that matched.

result_count.description: Number of distance results returned (may be less than the number of requested compare codes).

results.description: Array of distance results, one per matched comparison code. Codes with no match are omitted.

ZipcodeDistanceItem.description: Distance from the base point to one matched comparison code.

distance.description: Distance from the base point to this code, in the unit specified by the unit field (default km).

DistanceRequest.description: Request body specifying the base point, country, and comparison codes for distance calculation.

compare.description: List of ZIP or postal codes to calculate distance from the base point. Maximum 100 codes.

code.description: Base ZIP or postal code from which distances are calculated. Alternative to lat/long.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the base point. Required even when the base point is given as lat/long coordinates.

lat.description: Base latitude coordinate (-90 to 90). Alternative to code.

long.description: Base longitude coordinate (-180 to 180). Alternative to code.

unit.description: Distance unit for the returned values. Default: km.

DistanceCompareCode.description: A ZIP or postal code to compare against the base point.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
